hotels.title: Central Waikiki Oasis with Daily Breakfast, Rooftop Pool & Kids Stay Free
hotels.description: Experience the perfect fusion of mid-century modern design and iconic Hawaiian charm at this stunning hotel, ideally located amid Waikiki’s vibrant nightlife and bustling shopping precinct, just a short walk from the iconic sands of Waikiki Beach and just a block away from Kalakaua Avenue. As part of Marriott's Autograph Collection, this urban oasis exceeds expectations with a serene saltwater pool surrounded by lush greenery, complemented by an open-air lanai featuring cozy fire pits that overlook the lively streets of Waikiki. Indulge in a modern twist on Hawaiian cuisine at Hideout, where fusion-inspired dishes and signature cocktails are served in a tranquil, open-air setting with nightly live entertainment. Visit the Duke Kahanamoku statue, take a surfing lesson, stroll through streets lined with upscale boutiques and vibrant dining venues, explore O’ahu’s diverse attractions or visit International Market Place, located directly adjacent to the hotel. Within a short drive, you’ll find Pearl Harbor, Diamond Head State Monument and world-class shopping at Ala Moana Shopping Mall.
